title: Role object
summary: An object that represents a role

sections.title: Content
sections.text:
An API object that represents a role. | Name | Type/Value | Description | |------|------------|-------------| | uid | integer | Role's unique ID | | account_id | integer | SM account ID | | action_uid | string | Action UID. If it exists, progress can be tracked by the GET /actions/{uid} API (read-only) | | management | 'admin'
'db_member'
'db_viewer'
'cluster_member'
'cluster_viewer'
'user_manager'
'none' | [Management role](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#roles) | | name | string | Role's name | | resources | array of objects | Optional list of resource scopes that limit a `db_member` or `db_viewer` management role to specific databases. Each scope has a `type` (currently only `db`) and a `uids` array of database IDs the role applies to. If omitted or empty, the role applies to all databases. Example: `[{"type": "db", "uids": ["1", "2"]}]` |
